title: Inter Women 1-4 Man City, and two more Inter men are hurt
caption: Inter Women led in Monza through Elisa Bartoli's 24th-minute header, then lost 1-4 to Manchester City, per Inter.it. Marcus Thuram and Aleksandar Stankovic both left their national teams with muscle injuries, per Football Italia. #Inter #InterWomen #InterManCity #ForzaInter https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/tt/?ed=71
